messages.subject: Middle East Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Norwell,

Given NTS Group's executive-search platform across the Middle East and wider international markets, I am sharing my profile for confidential consideration in senior leadership mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My scope includes government and regulatory engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive advisory in a complex mining and industrial environment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional roles across government relations, external and corporate affairs, sustainability, stakeholder engagement, strategic partnerships and country leadership. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are my priority markets, followed by the wider GCC, and I am internationally mobile for expatriate appointments.

My executive CV is attached for your confidential review and inclusion in suitable current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
